title: Content-free Cloud Session status
description: The machine publishes SessionStatus on ss/<machine>/<session> and SessionStatusInventory on ss/<machine>/__clawdline_inventory_v1__. The private relay must grant read_sessions on ss/ and require read_transcript for the existing full s/ row. Older machines and relays may lack ss/.

observed_at.description: Unix seconds; zero when no observation time is known.

snapshot_generation.description: Pass id shared by every status row and the inventory marker of one set: which Sessions are listed and which execution each row speaks for. A viewer discards rows with a different value. It is stable while the set is, so an unchanged row is not re-sent and the one the relay retains remains the newest.

execution_generation.description: Random 128-bit machine-issued execution identity, absent unless this row's source is current and its process is pinned by PID and kernel start time.

parent_session_id.description: Terminal id of a currently listed parent Session, derived from the signed task or Epic owner relationship. No task text is copied.

machine_scope.description: True for the machine workspace Session, which sorts before ordinary Sessions.

inventory_complete.description: Whether the whole local scan was complete. False does not by itself revoke a currently observed row.

projected_at.description: Unix seconds when this status was projected.

last_movement_at.description: Unix seconds when the assistant's own record last grew; this is activity, not a claim of task progress.

no_progress_after_ms.description: Machine policy threshold in milliseconds for classifying no recent record movement.

no_movement.description: Absent when activity or current source evidence is unknown; false is a measured answer.

waiting_for_reply.description: True only when a current waiting row has a nonempty menu corroborated by a captured screen, or by a registry wait and an open single-question transcript menu while the screen is unavailable. No question or option text is copied. Absent means the reply signal is unavailable, not that no reply is needed.

completed_unconfirmed.description: True only for an unviewed Board delivery in phase done. A deploying item is not called complete.

attention_required.description: True only when a person-needed declaration or a positive attention count is known.

close_blocked.description: Measured only when closeability has a current source and a known state. True means closing is blocked, false means it is not; absent is unknown. It does not mean the whole Session or its work is blocked.

failed_agent_count.description: Count of provider-native background agents in failed state when their reading is complete and untruncated. Zero is measured; absent is unknown. It does not mean the Session failed.

at.description: Unix seconds of this inventory reading.

presentation_generation.description: Id of the machine's display facts, which carry no content here: a viewer re-reads the pinned machine list when it changes. Absent on an older machine, whose snapshot_generation moves with every display change instead.
